summary: Validated new Nubo features: AI Smart Search (POST /api/search/smart) and Admin Fleet Dashboard (/api/admin/stats, /api/admin/active-drivers) + public-register admin guard. 10/10 backend pytest pass. Frontend e2e (admin + customer flows) pass via Playwright. Google Maps placeholder error is expected and not blocking.

issues: Google Maps shows 'Oops! Something went wrong.' overlay because REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is the placeholder 'YOUR_API_KEY_HERE'. Documented as expected by main agent; consider hiding/replacing this block with a friendly fallback until a real key is provided.

action_items: (Optional) Replace the Google Maps error overlay with a friendlier placeholder until a real API key is configured.
(Optional) Smart Search performs two regex queries per request; consider caching LLM intent parsing or rate-limiting since each call hits gpt-5.4-mini.
(Optional, code quality) /app/backend/server.py is ~1159 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, orders, admin, search) per code review guidelines (>700 lines).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exceeds 700 lines (1159). Recommend modular split (auth, business, order, admin, search) for maintainability.

smart_search swallows LLM exceptions silently (only logs); response always 200 with fallback keyword extraction. Acceptable UX, but consider returning a flag like ai_used=false so frontend can show a hint.
admin_active_drivers merges in-memory manager.driver_locations with DB; ensure manager is process-local-safe in multi-worker setups (currently single uvicorn worker — fine for now).
GET /api/admin/stats and /admin/active-drivers correctly return 403 for both unauthenticated (HTTPBearer auto_error) and customer tokens — validated by tests.
Public /api/auth/register correctly rejects role='admin' with 400 — validated by tests.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded businesses (Test Restaurant Algeciras, Restaurante La Bahía, MRW) and 2 existing 'Test Driver' (motorcycle) accounts marked available.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (AI smart search + admin fleet dashboard + register admin guard) verified working end-to-end. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_nubo_features.py covers happy path + auth guards + register guard. Admin dashboard route is /dashboard (not /admin); App.js role-routes admins to AdminDashboard from /dashboard. Google Maps map widget always shows InvalidKeyMapError box — expected until a real REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is set.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in scope of this iteration.
